# scripts/Get-VaultHarvest.ps1

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

Proposes what a customer vault may contribute to the knowledge base: generalized estate facts, recurring findings, and runbook and lesson candidates.

Reads a vault built by vault/avd_second_brain.ps1 from avd-current-state packages (the latest inventory and validation snapshot of each environment, verified runbooks, lessons) and prints only generalized facts: a session host bucket, host pool types, VM families, the validator checks still failing (names only, never scopes), and the runbooks and lessons worth sharing with how many lines of each look like customer data. Nothing is written: a person, or the harvest skill, turns the proposal into a PR (docs/architecture.md, flow 2).

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `-VaultPath` | string | yes |  | The vault to read (built by vault/avd_second_brain.ps1). |
| `-Json` | switch | no |  | Print the proposal as JSON instead of text. |

## Examples

```powershell
./scripts/Get-VaultHarvest.ps1 -VaultPath ../contoso-avd-brain
```
```powershell
./scripts/Get-VaultHarvest.ps1 -VaultPath ../contoso-avd-brain -Json > harvest.json
```
